en.html:
...Rain, beginning lightly.
The thin walls let its sound carry.

Since beginning the bridge, I had been staying at Hikari's home. This was still Kamakura, if its outskirts; commuting from the chief's house would have been easy. I had my reasons.

I repaid my host with food and necessities. Given the times, and a child living alone, better than cash, I thought.

……少し、降り始めたようだ。
　
　壁が薄いからか、小雨の音がよく響く。

　橋の再建を始めてよりこのかた、俺は<ruby>光<rt>ひかり</rt></ruby>の家で厄介
になっている。
　外れとはいえ鎌倉市内。署長宅から通うに不都合は
無いのだが――理由あってこうしていた。

　家主への返礼は食料ほか生活必需品である。
　今の時勢そして子供の一人暮らしという事情を思う

en.html:
Once I had suggested living together. She answered without hesitation.
Shaking her head, Hikari said she would wait here for her mother.

I had not raised it since.
A mother who vanished without warning was almost certain not to return, I thought. Dead, of course not. Alive, probably not either.

But I did not think I should say so and argue her into agreement. It would do her no good. I kept silent.

She seemed alone. Yet her family still existed—so long as she believed it. I had no right to take that away on my own judgment.

Kindness, for me, meant respecting the distance between strangers, not crossing it. Leaving her sanctuary intact.
From that distance she was now watching me with an unreadable look.

ja.html:
一度、一緒に暮らさないかと持ち掛けてみた。
　その返答は迷いなく。

　ここで母の帰りを待つからと、光は首を横に振った。
　
　以来、その話はしていない。

　前触れもなく姿を消したという母親が戻る見込みは
皆無に近い――そう思う。
　死んでいれば当然、生きていてもだ。

　しかし、そこまで口にして光を説き伏せるべきとは
思われなかった。それは全く彼女にとって良い事では
ないと思えた。
　だから俺は口を噤んだ。

　彼女は独りきりに見える。
　だが家族は<ruby>まだいる<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>のだ――彼女がそう信じる限り。
俺の独断でそれを取り上げて良い筈はない。

　俺にできる親切とは、他人同士の距離を踏み越える
事ではなく守る事であった。彼女の聖域を侵さぬよう。
　その距離から今、光は俺に不分明な眼差しを注いで
いる。

Few words. Clear meaning. She meant my attempts to persuade the refugees and rebuild the bridge.
Had she watched it all? Or, without seeing, understood that I was trying hard, through some strange sense adults lacked?

Kageaki"Harmony is to be valued."
小光"Harmy?"
Kageaki"Harmony."
小光"Harmony."
Kageaki"Is to be valued."
小光"Is to be val-yood."
Kageaki"Yes."
小光"...What's that?"
Kageaki"Words of a great person long ago. Value getting along with one another."
Kageaki"Constant fighting achieves nothing. Help one another instead, and you can do anything... That is what it means."
小光"Anything?"
Kageaki"Yes. Grow food. Build houses."
小光"A zoo?"
Kageaki"Yes."
小光"A movie theater?"
Kageaki"Yes."
小光"Amazing..."
Kageaki"Yes. But—"
Kageaki"If we quarrel instead, not only can we not build such things, we may destroy them."
小光"Bad..."
Kageaki"Yes."
小光"How do you stop fighting and get along?"
Kageaki"..."

Kageaki"As you did for me."
小光"...?"
Kageaki"You gave someone your own food. Because he needed help more than you."
Kageaki"...Sounds simple. Difficult to do. Many are kind when they have plenty. Few manage it while suffering themselves."
Kageaki"In hardship people protect only themselves. Sometimes take from others to save themselves... You did not."
小光"..."
Kageaki"A very fine thing."
小光"...Oh..."
